title: Substructure Pad Foundation & Blockwork Engineering — Ijebu Ode
location: Taiwo Osipitan St, Ijebu Ode, Ogun State, Nigeria
shortDescription: Active substructure engineering and foundation construction in Ijebu Ode, Ogun State featuring excavated laterite pad footings, starter column reinforcement cages, concrete blinding, and sandcrete foundation blockwork.
overview: On-site civil and structural substructure execution in Ijebu Ode, Ogun State, Nigeria. Site photography from September through November 2026 documents deep laterite soil excavations, weak-concrete trench blinding, fabricated high-tensile steel pad mats and column starter cages, cast concrete pad footings, and rising sandcrete block foundation walls supervised by SPES Swiftpace field operatives.
objectives: Establish a stable load-bearing substructure within lateritic soil strata, ensure precise column grid geometry from starter cages, and construct properly aligned foundation blockwork walls ready for ground-beam capping and backfilling.
scopeOfWork: Setting out and trench/pit excavation, lean concrete blinding, pad footing and column starter rebar fabrication and tying, formwork boxing, pad concrete pouring, and substructure sandcrete masonry walling.
technicalApproach: Executed reinforced concrete isolated pad footings linked with starter column dowel cages anchored beneath blinding cover levels, followed by plumbed sandcrete block infill tied symmetrically around structural column pockets.
projectOutcome: Complete foundation footing grid and multi-bay substructure blockwork walls progressing on schedule with continuous SPES on-site supervision and PPE compliance.
